description: This file defines the EasyHandle class within the GuzzleHttp library, representing a cURL easy handle and managing its associated data, such as request, response, headers, and options. It includes methods for creating a response from headers and handling property access.

classes.name: EasyHandle
classes.description: A class representing a cURL easy handle to manage HTTP requests and responses within GuzzleHttp, encapsulating request, response, headers, options, and related error handling.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Constructs a GuzzleHttp Response object from the received headers and sink, handling content decoding and header normalization.
